key_impacts: PHIVOLCS issued tsunami Alert Level 3 (immediate evacuation) for coastal areas of six provinces.
All surveyed barangays reported an estimated average of 80% of residents evacuating after the alert.
No significant tsunami wave appeared and no damages were observed.
Power and communications disruptions occurred during the alert in some areas (mobile phone issues, power cuts, a wrong radio broadcast in one municipality).
evidence_snippets: 31 Aug 2012, PHIVOLCS issued tsunami Alert Level 3 (immediate evacuation) for coastal areas of Eastern Samar, Leyte, Northern Samar, Southern Leyte, Surigao del Norte/Sur.
However, no significant wave appeared and no damages were observed.
All surveyed barangays had an estimated average of 80% of the residents evacuating after the alert.
missing_information: Exact number of evacuees not provided.
Damage and casualty figures beyond 'none observed' are not detailed.
Specific affected localities within the named provinces are mostly unspecified.
